title: A Fief in the Central States
summary: The narration introduces the Central States: four immortal dynasties, nine ancient countries, and the Qishi Academy, which opens once every ten thousand years and admits only Holy Son-level prodigies. Ye Fan meant to go to the Central States but Hei Huang's formation lands him near Chunqiu City in Anping. There he rescues Princess Yu Die (Dragon Transformation) from Chiyang Kingdom cultivators who want to capture her. Calling himself 'Ye Zhetian', he is rewarded by her father, the lord of Anping, who promises him an ancient scripture. He is also given a city of his choice and picks Lu City, a cursed fief that the Xiao clan had held, which angers Xiao Mingyuan. In Lu City he kills the Xiao-backed city lord, who was bleeding the townsfolk dry to feed a dragon horse, and cooks the horse for the whole town. That brings in the barbarian Dongfang Ye, who becomes his friend and tells him about the Qishi Academy's Immortal Palace trial. The dragon horse belonged to Princess Qi, and Ye Fan beats the suitors she sends after him.
